title: A PAYOUT REFUND on a FRAUD charged-off loan posts the same legs as the merchant-issued arm: CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 367.00, INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_INTEREST 20.00, INCOME_FROM_CHARGE_OFF_FEES 113.00 (fee 103.00 + penalty 10.00 merged), then debits the resolved fund source 1 500.00 exactly ONCE (loan 17 L52)
_note: Parity vector transcribing the journal entry a PAYOUT REFUND posted on a loan ALREADY MARKED CHARGED OFF and FRAUD, the payout-refund arm of createJournalEntriesForRepaymentWhenLoanIsChargedOff, on the ChargeOff-Part1 MNT capture (tenant tierd, currency MNT, 2 minor digits, loan 17, loanProductId 3, chargedOff true, fraud true) at refund transaction L52. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.transaction_id is L52, kind is payout_refund and fraud is true. request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.portions transcribes the loan read-back's payoutRefund transaction id 52 (externalId b6f80395-0316-49e2-8558-a9515d805bfb, type Payout Refund id 22, paymentDetailData.paymentType.id 5 AUTOPAY, manuallyReversed false): principalPortion 367.0 -> "36700", interestPortion 20.0 -> "2000", feeChargesPortion 103.0 -> "10300", penaltyChargesPortion 10.0 -> "1000", overpaymentPortion 0 -> "0". request.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal.accounts is the product's accountingMappings with the fund source RESOLVED through the payment channel, read from product-mappings/create-request-LP1_INTEREST_FLAT.json (sha256 d799095b...) and the oracle's echo product-mappings/product-20-retrieve-one-response.json (sha256 c01fa811...): chargeOffExpenseAccountId 14, chargeOffFraudExpenseAccountId 13, incomeFromChargeOffInterestAccountId 20, incomeFromChargeOffFeesAccountId 11, incomeFromChargeOffPenaltyAccountId 11, overpaymentLiabilityAccountId 16, incomeFromRecoveryAccountId 17, fundSourceAccountId 1; the ONLY paymentChannelToFundSourceMappings entry is paymentTypeId 1 -> 18, so paymentType 5 (AUTOPAY) has no channel mapping and resolves to the product fund source 1. expect.charged_off_merchant_refund_journal_legs is a TRANSCRIPTION of the four L52 legs in id order from journalentries/loan-17/loan-17-journalentries-3.json: JE 149 CREDIT glAccountId 13 367.0 (Credit Loss/Bad Debt-Fraud), JE 150 CREDIT glAccountId 20 20.0 (Interest Income Charge Off), JE 151 CREDIT glAccountId 11 113.0 (Fee Charge Off; the 103.0 fee and 10.0 penalty portions MERGE into one credit), JE 152 DEBIT glAccountId 1 500.0 (Suspense/Clearing account). THIS VECTOR GRADES THE SAME ONE PROPERTY AS THE MERCHANT-ISSUED FRAUD OBSERVATION, and it is the evidence that the two arms post IDENTICALLY: a payout refund on a charged-off FRAUD loan credits the principal portion to CHARGE_OFF_FRAUD_EXPENSE 13, the interest to 20, the fee and penalty portions MERGED into one 113.00 credit to 11, and debits the total 500.00 exactly ONCE to the resolved fund source 1 -- the same accounts, sides, amounts and leg count the merchant-issued arm posts. A port that either refuses the payout kind or ignores the fraud flag fails here. WHAT THIS VECTOR DOES NOT GRADE: a positive overpayment portion (zero here), the goodwill-credit arm, a zero-total case, or any leg difference between the two refund arms (there is none). Nothing was computed by this promotion: every portion, account and leg is read directly from the committed files.
